## Goal
The repo no longer offers a rollback to a `finbot-spike` connector that doesn't exist. The cutover is done, so its scripts
are retired.

## Scope
- Remove `deploy/rollback.sh`, `deploy/rollback-remote.sh`, `deploy/cutover.sh`, `deploy/cutover-remote.sh` and
  `deploy/rehearse.sh`, after checking what else calls them (`git grep`).
- Keep `deploy/deploy.sh`, `deploy/compose.yaml` and the `tunnel-active` marker logic: `deploy.sh` still needs the marker to
  enable the `tunnel` profile. Fix any comment in those two files that names the spike.
- Keep `deploy/rehearse-docker.sh` if it doesn't depend on a removed script; otherwise trim it to what still applies.

## Out of scope
- Touching hoid, or removing the marker there. `tests/acceptance/M2/` (historical; list any reference under Docs follow-ups).

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] `git grep -nE 'rollback(-remote)?\.sh|cutover(-remote)?\.sh' -- deploy` → no matches.
- [ ] `bash -n deploy/deploy.sh` passes, and the marker check is still in it (`grep -c tunnel-active deploy/deploy.sh` ≥ 1).
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green
